title: Capers Eat & Drink
venue_description:
Capers Eat & Drink

Capers Eat & Drink is a friendly American bistro and bar on West Campbell Avenue in Campbell California. Locals know it for prime rib and generous happy hours but musicians across the South Bay know it for something else: one of the busiest and warmest Monday open mics in the region. It is a neighborhood spot where dinner crowds and songwriters share the same room and where regulars quickly start to feel like family.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Capers is casual and unpretentious. The dining room and bar feel like a classic suburban hangout with booths and a busy bar and there is pet-friendly outdoor seating for warm evenings. On open mic nights the room takes on what regulars call a found-family atmosphere. The crowd is supportive and relaxed and many first-time performers say it was the place that got them comfortable on stage.

Food and Drinks

The kitchen serves American bistro fare with prime rib and shareable samplers among the favorites. Happy hour runs daily from 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM with a late-night happy hour before closing and Mondays bring all-day deals which makes open mic night an easy dinner plan. Weekly drink specials include half-price well martinis early in the week and margarita deals on Thursdays. Weekend brunch runs from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Monday Open Mic

The Capers Open Mic runs every Monday from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM with host Cathy Cook. Walk-in sign-up opens at 5:30 PM and a line usually forms by then because the list almost always fills. Each performer gets two songs or 10 minutes whichever comes first and the night is music only. The event is all ages. Sound is handled by Firooz and Laura who keep the mix clean all night and a keyboard is sometimes available for piano players.

  • When: Mondays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 5:30 PM
  • Format: Two songs or 10 minutes
  • Gear: House PA with keys sometimes available

More Music at Capers

Capers keeps the entertainment going through the week with live music on Friday nights and karaoke on Saturdays. It is a good room to catch local cover bands and acoustic acts and the karaoke nights draw a lively crowd.

Why Musicians Love It

Capers gives South Bay players a reliable weekly stage with good sound and a genuinely encouraging audience. It is an ideal place to try out a new song meet other local musicians and find collaborators. Arrive early grab dinner at the bar and enjoy one of the most consistent open mics in Silicon Valley.

Good to Know

Capers Eat & Drink is at 1710 W Campbell Avenue in Campbell California 95008. Call (408) 374-5777 or visit caperseatanddrink.com. Follow the venue on Facebook and Instagram for updates.

title: Barnhouse Napa Brews
venue_description:
Barnhouse Napa Brews

Barnhouse Napa Brews is a cozy community hub on Clinton Street in downtown Napa. By day it is a coffee shop and by night it becomes a laid-back pub with craft beer and a steady lineup of music and community events. In a valley famous for wine Barnhouse is a welcome change of pace where locals gather to sip a pint catch a show or step up to the mic.

Atmosphere and Vibe

True to its name Barnhouse has a rustic barn-style feel with a friendly small-town energy. The space is welcoming to all ages which makes it a rare downtown Napa venue where families students and longtime locals mix. The staff and regulars are known for making first-timers feel at home.

Drinks and Food

Barnhouse pours craft beer on tap alongside coffee and espresso drinks and light bites. It is a stop on the Napa Valley beer scene and a comfortable place to settle in for a whole evening of music.

Community Open Mic on Mondays

The Barnhouse Community Open Mic runs every Monday from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM with host Erin D. The event moved from Sundays to Mondays in fall 2025. Look for the clipboard at the counter around 6:00 PM to sign up. Each performer gets two songs or 10 minutes and anything goes with music and poetry both welcome. The house asks that performers keep political content off the stage.

  • When: Mondays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 6:00 PM
  • Format: Two songs or 10 minutes
  • Gear: House PA with three mics plus a house keyboard and an aux input for tracks
  • Ages: All ages

More Music and Events

Barnhouse is known around town for its Dueling Guitars nights where local players trade songs and requests with the crowd. Weekly pub trivia and other community nights round out the calendar and local acts often play on weekends.

Why Musicians Love It

The house keyboard and backing track input make Barnhouse friendly to pianists and singers who perform to tracks and the all-ages policy opens the door to young performers. It is one of the most welcoming weekly stages in Napa County.

Good to Know

Barnhouse Napa Brews is at 1004 Clinton Street in Napa California 94559. Call (707) 690-6272 or visit barnhousenapa.com and follow Barnhouse on Facebook for the latest events.

title: The Crepe Place
venue_description:
The Crepe Place

The Crepe Place is a beloved Santa Cruz institution on Soquel Avenue that doubles as a restaurant and one of the most important small music rooms on the Central Coast. Diners come for sweet and savory crepes and music fans come for an intimate back room that has hosted a long parade of indie folk rock and Americana acts from Santa Cruz and around the world.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Crepe Place feels like a funky Santa Cruz living room. There is a cozy dining room a garden patio and a separate performance space with a small stage where audiences stand close enough to see every chord change. The crowd is a mix of students locals and devoted music lovers and the staff keep the mood easygoing.

Food and Drinks

The menu centers on crepes with savory options for dinner and sweet crepes for dessert along with salads and other plates. A full bar serves beer wine and cocktails. The kitchen is open daily from late morning until 10:00 PM.

Live Music

The Crepe Place books ticketed shows through much of the week. The calendar leans toward indie rock folk singer-songwriter Americana psych and alternative acts and it is a regular stop for touring bands working the West Coast. Many well-known artists played this room early in their careers which gives it a reputation as a place to discover your next favorite band.

Open Mic and Taco Mondays

Every other Monday The Crepe Place hosts an open mic paired with Taco Mondays. Sign-up is in person at 6:30 PM and the music runs from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM. The night is music only and runs through the house PA. The show is 21 and over.

  • When: Every other Monday from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 6:30 PM
  • Format: Music only
  • Gear: House PA
  • Ages: 21 and over

Why Musicians Love It

Playing the same stage that hosts touring bands is a thrill for local songwriters and the audience at The Crepe Place knows how to listen. Tacos and a drink before your set make it an easy night out.

Good to Know

The Crepe Place is at 1134 Soquel Avenue in Santa Cruz California 95062. Call (831) 429-6994 or check thecrepeplace.com to confirm open mic dates since the event runs every other week.

title: Dick's Place
venue_description:
Dick's Place

Dick's Place is a historic saloon on Main Street in the village of Mendocino on the Northern California coast. Ricardo Dick Checci opened it in 1934 just after Prohibition ended and it has been pouring drinks for locals fishermen artists and travelers ever since. It is one of only two bars in Mendocino and its red martini-glass sign is famously the only neon sign in town.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The saloon sits in a classic wood-frame building with a view of the rugged Mendocino coastline. Inside you will find Giants memorabilia pinball machines and a dartboard in the back room. The mood is warm convivial and very much a neighborhood bar where visitors are welcomed like regulars.

Drinks

Dick's Place runs a full bar with a good beer list and quality spirits and it is especially well known for its Bloody Marys. It is cash only with an ATM on site and it stays open late for this sleepy coastal village.

Monday Open Mic

Every Monday at 8:00 PM Dick's Place hosts an open mic run by local musician Frank Lucky. Sign-up is walk-in and set length depends on how many performers show up. Anything goes and all genres are welcome. A house PA is provided. The event is 21 and over.

  • When: Mondays from 8:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person
  • Host: Frank Lucky
  • Gear: House PA
  • Ages: 21 and over

Why Musicians Love It

For musicians on the Mendocino coast Dick's is the place to meet other players and try new material in front of an easygoing crowd. For travelers it is a chance to play a historic small-town saloon on a trip up Highway 1.

Good to Know

Dick's Place is at 45070 Main Street in Mendocino California 95460. Call (707) 937-6010. Hours are generally 11:30 AM to 2:00 AM daily. Remember to bring cash.

title: Gardino's
venue_description:
Gardino's

Gardino's is an Italian restaurant bar and live music spot on North Santa Cruz Avenue in the heart of downtown Los Gatos. It blends hearty Italian dining with a nightlife calendar packed with karaoke local bands and jam nights which makes it one of the liveliest evening stops in town.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Gardino's has a fun neighborhood energy. Early evening diners linger over pasta and wine and later the room fills with singers players and friends out for a good time. The vibe is relaxed and low-pressure and the staff enjoys the music as much as the crowd.

Food and Drinks

The kitchen serves classic Italian dishes with a full bar pouring wine beer and cocktails. It is an easy place to grab dinner before the music gets going.

Monday Karaoke and Open Mic

Monday nights start with karaoke from about 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM and then the stage turns into an open mic from 9:30 PM until midnight. Hosts Kyle Morrill and Tyler run the night with walk-in sign-up. Anything goes and a house PA is provided.

  • When: Mondays from 9:30 PM to Midnight
  • Sign Up: In person
  • Hosts: Kyle Morrill and Tyler
  • Gear: House PA

More Music at Gardino's

Gardino's promotes live entertainment most nights of the week. Its entertainment calendar lists blues jam nights midweek plus local bands on Thursday Friday and Saturday nights and afternoon music on Sundays. Schedules change so check the Gardino's Facebook page for the current lineup.

Why Musicians Love It

A late start makes the Gardino's open mic a great second stop for players coming from earlier Monday mics in the South Bay. The mix of karaoke singers and instrumentalists creates a fun crowd that is always ready to cheer.

Good to Know

Gardino's is at 51 N Santa Cruz Avenue in Los Gatos California 95030. Call (408) 354-4788 or visit gardinoslg.com.
location: 51 N Santa Cruz Ave, Los Gatos, CA 95030

title: The Bistro
venue_description:
The Bistro

The Bistro in downtown Hayward calls itself a beer drinking pub with a music problem and it has lived up to that motto since 1994. It is an East Bay favorite for craft beer lovers and musicians alike with live music every day of the week and never a cover charge.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Bistro is a true neighborhood pub where bartenders know regulars by name and the patio fills up on sunny afternoons. It is dog-friendly and relaxed with a crowd that spans longtime Hayward locals and beer fans who travel for the tap list.

Beer and Food

Twenty craft beers flow from the taps with a rotating selection of Belgian ales and more than fifty beers available to go. Wine and appetizers are also on offer. The Bistro is known for its annual Double IPA Festival which celebrated its 26th year in February 2026 and draws hop fans from across the region.

Monday Open Mic

The Monday open mic runs from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM with sign-up at the bar at 6:30 PM. Hosting rotates through the month: Janet Lenore and Jeff Davis on first Mondays Emenefer on second Mondays Jim Safer on third Mondays Spirit Flute on fourth Mondays and Mike Meagher on the occasional fifth Monday. Covers are welcome originals are encouraged and spoken word is welcome too.

  • When: Mondays from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person at the bar from 6:30 PM
  • Gear: House PA and house piano
  • Ages: 21 and over

Live Music Every Day

Beyond the open mic The Bistro books local bands across rock blues jazz folk and roots styles throughout the week. With no cover it is easy to drop in and discover new East Bay talent any night.

Why Musicians Love It

A house piano rotating hosts and a supportive crowd make The Bistro one of the most well-rounded open mics in the East Bay. It is also a great place to meet players for bands and side projects.

Good to Know

The Bistro is at 1001 B Street in Hayward California 94541. Call (510) 833-3470 or visit the-bistro.com. Hours run from mid-afternoon on weekdays and from noon on weekends.

title: Henflings Tavern
venue_description:
Henflings Tavern

Henflings Tavern is a historic roadhouse on Highway 9 in Ben Lomond deep in the redwoods of the San Lorenzo Valley. It has been a gathering spot in the Santa Cruz Mountains since 1946 and today it is the heart of the mountain music scene with open mics jams and live bands every week.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Henflings is a classic mountain tavern. A shady front deck sits under an old oak tree and there is a heated covered patio pool and darts and big screens for game days. Regulars say newcomers become family before they know it. On music nights the small roadhouse stage puts players right in the middle of the party.

Food and Drinks

A full bar and a kitchen serving hot meals keep the crowd fed and the kitchen often runs late on music nights. There is no cover for most shows.

Monday Open Mic

Henflings Open Mic Mondays run from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM with host Christian Walsh. Sign-up is walk-in first come first served and each act gets three songs or 15 minutes. Anything goes: bring your guitar your voice your poetry or comedy or even a dance routine. It is the only Monday live music night in the Santa Cruz Mountains.

  • When: Mondays from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person first come first served
  • Format: Three songs or 15 minutes
  • Gear: House PA
  • Ages: 21 and over

Sunday Mountain Pro Jam

Sunday evenings from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM Henflings hosts its long-running Pro Jam led by Dan Odom who has run the Sunday jam for about a decade. Bass players drummers guitarists and singers rotate through the stage and the jam draws seasoned players from across Santa Cruz County.

Weekend Live Music

Weekends bring regional bands playing rock blues country and roots music. The calendar is posted weekly on the Henflings Facebook page.

Good to Know

Henflings Tavern is at 9450 Highway 9 in Ben Lomond California 95005. Call (831) 289-3019 or email info.henflingstavern@gmail.com. Visit henflingsslv.com for the latest schedule. The tavern is 21 and over.

title: The Hotel Utah Saloon
venue_description:
The Hotel Utah Saloon

The Hotel Utah Saloon at 4th and Bryant in San Francisco's SoMa district is one of the city's most storied music rooms. The building dates to 1908 and predates the Bay Bridge. Paul Gaer bought the bar in 1977 renamed it The Utah and built the stage that has since hosted everyone from Whoopi Goldberg and Robin Williams to generations of independent bands and songwriters.

History

The original owners the Deininger family commissioned an ornate back bar from Belgian furniture makers and that mahogany bar still anchors the room today. The saloon survived Prohibition served longshoremen and merchants and in the 1950s became famous for a bartender who cut off patrons' neckties with scissors. Its open mic dates back to 1977 and is among the oldest in the country.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Utah feels artsy eclectic and creative. A small stage with professional sound and lights faces the bar and a loft overlooks the room. The kitchen cooks real food onsite and the crowd mixes tech workers neighborhood regulars and musicians from all over the Bay.

Monday Open Mic

The Hotel Utah Monday Open Mic runs from 8:00 PM until last call with host Carly Beltramo. Names are drawn from a hat at 8:00 PM with sign-up opening at 7:45 PM and you can also comment your name on the Facebook event post around 7:00 PM. Each performer gets one song or up to six minutes. A featured performer plays a 30-minute set at 9:00 PM. Covers backing tracks and spoken word are welcome and performances are streamed online.

  • When: Mondays from 8:00 PM until last call
  • Sign Up: In person from 7:45 PM with a hat draw at 8:00 PM
  • Gear: House PA house guitar piano two vocal mics one instrument mic and two instrument cables
  • Ages: 21 and over

Tuesday Open Bluegrass Jam

Every Tuesday from about 7:00 PM to 10:30 PM the Utah hosts a free Open Bluegrass Jam. It is an informal circle where banjos fiddles mandolins and guitars trade tunes and newcomers are welcome to sit in or just listen.

Shows and Specials

The rest of the calendar features ticketed shows spanning punk rock folk bluegrass comedy and experimental music. Happy hour runs 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM on weekdays and noon to 4:00 PM on weekends and Wednesdays bring wing specials. The loft and stage can host private events for up to 200 guests.

Good to Know

The Hotel Utah Saloon is at 500 4th Street in San Francisco California 94107. Call (415) 546-6300 or email info@hotelutah.com. Visit hotelutah.com for the calendar.

title: Longboard Bar and Venue
venue_description:
Longboard Bar and Venue

Longboard Bar and Venue is a surf-town party spot in Pacifica's Eureka Square just south of San Francisco. What started as a margarita bar has grown into one of the Peninsula coast's busiest live music rooms with rock bands on weekends and a high-energy open mic every Monday.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Longboard is loud social and beachy. Regulars describe it as a margaritaville of awesomeness and the owner's philosophy says it all: all musicians welcome even the ones that are not weird. Expect a festive crowd strong drinks and plenty of dancing.

Drinks

Margaritas are the house specialty along with a full bar and beer. It is a favorite spot for locals after a day on the coast.

Monday Open Mic

The Longboard Open Mic runs every Monday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM hosted by Lightholder. The night has a band-e-oke flavor and the house sound system is the same robust rig that handles rock bands on other nights. A house band is often on hand to back up performers so singers can step up without bringing a group.

  • When: Mondays from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person
  • Host: Lightholder
  • Gear: Full house PA with a house band often available
  • Ages: 21 and over

Live Music and Events

Longboard books rock cover bands tribute acts and local originals on weekends and hosts karaoke and special events through the week. Ticketed shows are listed on Eventbrite and the venue's Instagram.

Why Musicians Love It

Few open mics offer a real rock sound system and a backing band. Longboard is the place to sing with a full band or plug in your electric and play loud.

Good to Know

Longboard Bar and Venue is at 180 Eureka Square in Pacifica California 94044. Call (650) 733-7934 or visit longboardbar.com.

title: Melo Melo Kava Bar
venue_description:
Melo Melo Kava Bar

Melo Melo Kava Bar on Pacific Avenue in downtown Santa Cruz is a nakamal or kava bar that brings a South Pacific tradition to the Central Coast. It offers an alcohol-free place to relax and socialize and every Monday it becomes one of the most welcoming open mic rooms in town.

What Is Kava

Kava is an ancient beverage from the South Pacific made from the roots of the kava plant. It has been shared in island communities for centuries and is known for its calming social effect. Melo Melo serves traditional kava along with other botanical drinks and teas.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Melo Melo is mellow by design. The room is laid back and friendly and draws students artists and anyone looking for a night out without alcohol. It is open daily from noon to midnight which makes it a late-night hangout on the downtown strip.

Monday Open Mic

The Melo Melo Open Mic runs every Monday from 8:00 PM to 10:30 PM with sign-up at 7:00 PM. Musicians of all styles are welcome and the attentive sober crowd makes it a great room for quiet songs and new material.

  • When: Mondays from 8:00 PM to 10:30 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 7:00 PM

Why Musicians Love It

An alcohol-free room means a listening audience and a welcoming space for performers of every age. It is a relaxed place to build confidence and connect with the downtown Santa Cruz creative community.

Good to Know

Melo Melo Kava Bar is at 1101 Pacific Avenue Suite D in Santa Cruz California 95060. Call (831) 854-7881 or visit melomelokavabar.com.
location: 1101 Pacific Ave Ste D, Santa Cruz, CA 95060

title: The PG Meetinghouse
venue_description:
The PG Meetinghouse

The PG Meetinghouse on Lighthouse Avenue in Pacific Grove is a coffee house community living room and music venue in one. Owner Scott Soifer transformed the former Juice N Java into a gathering place he calls the town square by day and a live music room by night. A remodel completed in early 2026 added a Yamaha grand piano and a full bar.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The room has wooden floors high ceilings with embossed burgundy tiles and a deep blue mural behind the stage. Community groups meet here during the day and at night the stage lights come up for music. Soifer sums up the new evening vibe as moving from a PG rating to PG-13.

Food and Drinks

Coffee espresso chai and hot chocolate anchor the daytime menu along with pretzels quiche and antipasto skewers. The new bar pours craft beer wine and spirits from whiskey to mezcal which is notable in Pacific Grove a town with a long history as a dry community.

Monday Open Mic

The PG Meetinghouse Open Mic runs Mondays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM hosted by Cleo Kent-Davy and Sky. The event moved from Tuesdays to Mondays in late July 2026. Walk-in sign-up opens at 5:00 PM and each performer gets about two songs. Acoustic music of any style is welcome and the event is all ages.

  • When: Mondays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 5:00 PM
  • Gear: House PA with a grand piano
  • Ages: All ages

More Music and Events

The weekly calendar includes trivia night karaoke Loud and Local band nights jazz evenings and a Sunday music brunch featuring young jazz players. On Monday mornings the venue hosts a live local radio show broadcast from Pacific Grove.

Why Musicians Love It

A grand piano is a rare treat at an open mic and the all-ages policy welcomes young performers from across the Monterey Peninsula. The supportive community crowd makes it a great place to debut original songs.

Good to Know

The PG Meetinghouse is at 599 Lighthouse Avenue in Pacific Grove California 93950. Call (831) 373-8652 or visit pgmeetinghouse.com.

title: Red Rock Coffee
venue_description:
Red Rock Coffee

Red Rock Coffee is a two-story coffee house at the corner of Castro and Villa in downtown Mountain View. It is a hub for students remote workers and neighbors and it is home to what is often called the longest-running open mic in the Bay Area. Every Monday the upstairs study space turns into a stage.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Red Rock has an artsy eclectic creative vibe. Regulars describe the Monday open mic as calming and relaxing and say everyone knows each other. The audience tends to be mature and attentive and the room welcomes families since the event is all ages.

Coffee and Food

Red Rock roasts and serves specialty coffee along with teas and pastries. It is an easy place to settle in before the music starts.

Monday Open Mic

The Red Rock Open Mic runs every Monday from 6:00 PM to about 9:00 PM on the second floor with host Ashley Markowicz. The lottery opens at 5:45 PM and names are drawn at random so everyone has a fair shot. Enter your name in person once any time before the lottery closes. Each performer gets about five minutes. Musicians are the most common performers but comedians and poets appear too.

  • When: Mondays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person lottery from 5:45 PM
  • Format: About five minutes each
  • Gear: House PA with a Yamaha keyboard cajon three vocal mics instrument cables music stand and aux cables for tracks
  • Ages: All ages with family-friendly content

House Rules

Content should stay family friendly and respectful and political material is discouraged. Full drum kits are not allowed due to space. Covers and originals are both welcome.

Why Musicians Love It

The lottery keeps the lineup fresh and gets lots of performers on stage. Host Ashley Markowicz emphasizes community and collaboration and many creative partnerships have started in this room.

Good to Know

Red Rock Coffee is at 201 Castro Street in Mountain View California 94041. Call (650) 967-4473 and visit redrockcoffee.com/openmic. Follow @redrockopenmic on Instagram for updates.

title: The Riptide
venue_description:
The Riptide

The Riptide on Taraval Street calls itself the Bay Area's best little honky-tonk by the beach. Tucked a few blocks from Ocean Beach in San Francisco's Outer Sunset it offers a roaring fireplace cold drinks and live music 365 days a year with never a cover charge.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Riptide is a cozy wood-paneled beach bar with a rustic cabin feel. Surfers locals and music fans gather around the fireplace on foggy nights. It is dog friendly and relaxed and the crowd always turns up for the music.

Monday Open Mic

The Riptide Open Mic runs every Monday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM hosted by Les. Walk-in sign-up opens at 7:00 PM and stays open until close. The night is music only with covers and originals in every genre welcome. Because the night runs late performers often get more than one turn.

  • When: Mondays from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 7:00 PM
  • Gear: House PA house mics house guitar and piano
  • Ages: 21 and over

Live Music Every Night

The Riptide books live music DJs and karaoke every night of the week. Expect country bluegrass rockabilly folk and rock bands from around the Bay plus themed nights that keep the neighborhood coming back.

Why Musicians Love It

A house guitar and piano mean you can show up with nothing but your voice and the chance for multiple sets makes it a great workout for new material. The Riptide is one of the friendliest rooms in San Francisco.

Good to Know

The Riptide is at 3639 Taraval Street at 47th Avenue in San Francisco California 94116. Call (415) 681-8433 or visit riptidesf.com.

title: The Ugly Mug
venue_description:
The Ugly Mug

The Ugly Mug is a beloved coffee house on Soquel Drive in the village of Soquel just outside Santa Cruz. Founder Steve Volk opened it in 1996 inspired by the beatnik cafes of the past and it has hosted a Monday open mic since 1999. Today it is also one of the Central Coast's favorite listening rooms for intimate acoustic concerts.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Mug captures the spirit of a 1990s coffee house with eclectic decor collected over the years and comfy spots to hang out with friends. Volk says coffee keeps the doors open but the real mission is human connection and that shows in the warm supportive crowd.

Coffee and Food

The cafe serves carefully sourced coffee along with pastries breakfast sandwiches and quiche. Locally baked croissants and kouign amann are popular with regulars.

Monday Open Mic

The Ugly Mug Open Mic runs every Monday from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Names go into a hat for a lottery draw and each performer gets two songs or 10 minutes. The room is acoustic only with no amplification so it is ideal for unplugged guitar voice and spoken word. Music poetry originals and covers are all welcome and the event is all ages.

  • When: Mondays from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person lottery
  • Format: Two songs or 10 minutes
  • Gear: Acoustic only with no house PA
  • Ages: All ages

Concerts at the Mug

The Ugly Mug books ticketed evening concerts by singer-songwriters folk and acoustic artists. Past shows have included touring songwriters and local favorites in an up-close setting.

Good to Know

The Ugly Mug is at 4640 Soquel Drive in Soquel California 95073. Call (831) 477-1341 or visit cafeugly.com for the concert calendar.

title: Vinnie's Bar & Grill
venue_description:
Vinnie's Bar & Grill

Vinnie's Bar & Grill is a downtown Concord bar and grill a block from Todos Santos Park and a short walk from Concord BART. It is a laid-back neighborhood spot with pool tables darts and a backyard patio and it hosts one of the biggest band-friendly open mics in the East Bay.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Vinnie's is eclectic and welcoming. It is open from 11:00 AM to 2:00 AM daily and serves breakfast and pub fare like burgers wings and salads. On music nights the huge stage and sound system turn the bar into a real rock room and dancing is encouraged.

Monday Open Mic

Vinnie's Open Mic runs every Monday from 8:45 PM to midnight with hosts Joey Nunez and Vince Lay. Sign-up is in person at 8:00 PM. Performers get two songs depending on length and full bands are welcome. Solo performers can be backed by house players on bass guitar drums keys and sometimes trumpet. Covers and backing tracks are welcome and originals are encouraged. Comedy opens the night every third Monday.

  • When: Mondays from 8:45 PM to Midnight
  • Sign Up: In person from 8:00 PM
  • Gear: Full drum kit full backline house PA and keyboards
  • Hosts: Joey Nunez and Vince Lay

More Music

Vinnie's hosts live bands and events through the week. Follow @thevinniesbar on Instagram for the current lineup.

Why Musicians Love It

Vinnie's is a perfect open mic for a full band that wants to test songs on a big stage without renting a rehearsal hall. The house band makes it just as good for solo singers.

Good to Know

Vinnie's Bar & Grill is at 2045 Mt Diablo Street in Concord California 94520. Call (925) 685-9515 or visit vinniesbar.com. Free parking is available at the Salvio Street garage.

title: The Big Easy
venue_description:
The Big Easy

Tucked below street level in American Alley in historic downtown Petaluma California The Big Easy is an underground restaurant and nightclub with the soul of a New Orleans jazz cellar. Run alongside its sister spot the Speakeasy Bistro it has become one of the North Bay's most beloved listening rooms with live music nearly every night of the week and a calendar that runs from big band jazz and blues to funk rock folk hip-hop and tribute acts.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Finding The Big Easy is part of the fun. You head down a back alley and step down into a hidden speakeasy-style club that feels a world away from the street above. The room is intimate and warm with a proper stage and a professional full-stage sound system so every note lands. Guests describe friendly staff and an electric late-night energy and the crowd tends to be a mix of serious listeners dancers and locals out for a good night. On the busiest nights the dance floor fills up fast so dancing shoes are encouraged.

Food and Drinks

The Big Easy serves American fare from the Speakeasy kitchen with the meat tacos a frequent favorite among regulars and dietary accommodations available on request. The full bar pours Sonoma County wines craft beer and cocktails made with Sonoma-made spirits which makes it easy to settle in for a full evening of music.

Live Music at The Big Easy

Music is the heart of this room. The club hosts a steady mix of ticketed shows and free nights covering nearly every genre. Recent lineups have included blues bands funk and rock outfits singer-songwriters flamenco hip-hop and R&B showcases and Grateful Dead tributes along with touring acts passing through the Bay Area. A few regular series anchor the week:

  • Wednesdays: Free big band jazz night with a full big band swinging through the standards
  • Third Thursdays: The Heard Thursday with local band The Heard Eye playing funk and rock originals with no cover
  • Weekends: Ticketed and free shows from local and touring artists across many styles

Songwriters Open Mic on First Mondays

On the first Monday of every month The Big Easy hosts the Songwriters Open Mic with longtime host Kevin Hutchinson. Billed as the longest-running original material open mic in the North Bay it draws songwriters from across Sonoma County and sometimes from across the country. Many performers are recording artists road-testing new songs in a relaxed low-pressure room with an attentive crowd.

  • When: First Mondays from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 6:30 PM
  • Format: Original songs only with sets of about three songs or 15 minutes
  • Gear: House PA with professional stage sound
  • Cost: Free to attend

Sunday Funday Blues Jam

Sunday nights belong to the blues. The Sunday Funday Blues Jam bills itself as the hottest blues jam in the North Bay and welcomes musicians dancers and blues lovers alike. The jam honors the greats who came before while giving players a stage to sit in with established and up-and-coming blues musicians. This is a player's jam so come ready to play. Recent listings show the jam starting at 7:00 PM but check the venue calendar or Facebook page for the current schedule.

Why Musicians Love It

For performers The Big Easy offers something rare: a real stage a great sound system and a room full of people who came to listen. Whether you are a songwriter trying out a brand-new tune a blues guitarist looking to trade solos on a Sunday night or a horn player who wants to catch the Wednesday big band The Big Easy is one of the best places in Sonoma County to connect with the local music community.
